Animation

Source: R/animation.R
AnimationClass.Rd

Base class for animations. An animation changes its mobject over run_time seconds, mapping time through rate_func. lag_ratio staggers submobjects: 0 animates them together, 1 one after another.

Usage

Animation(
  mobject = NULL,
  lag_ratio = DEFAULT_ANIMATION_LAG_RATIO,
  run_time = DEFAULT_ANIMATION_RUN_TIME,
  rate_func = smooth_rate,
  reverse_rate_function = FALSE,
  name = NULL,
  remover = FALSE,
  suspend_mobject_updating = TRUE,
  introducer = FALSE,
  on_finish = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

mobject

The mobject to animate.

lag_ratio

Stagger between submobjects.

run_time

Duration in seconds.

rate_func

A rate function.

reverse_rate_function

Run the rate function backwards.

name

Name used in progress messages.

remover

Remove the mobject from the scene when done.

suspend_mobject_updating

Pause the mobject's updaters while running.

introducer

Add the mobject to the scene when the animation starts.

on_finish

Optional function called with the scene when the animation is cleaned up from it.

...

Ignored.

Value

An Animation, an R6 object to pass to a scene's play(). AnimationClass is its R6 class generator.
